prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of Huang Gai from the Romance of the Three Kingdoms, reimagined as an adult woman — the veteran who offered her own back to the lash to light the fire at Red Cliffs. Age: early thirties — a poised, graceful face with soft contours; at most faint lines, no deep folds or under-eye bags. She is a woman — no beard, moustache or facial hair.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour, skin tone, costume and weapon are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): Korean MMORPG character artwork. A recognisably drawn face with gently simplified anatomical structure. 2D painting with visible brushwork: layered strokes of colour, soft broken edges, thin coloured linework and a few crisp accents on the face and costume.

Inspiration only: self-sacrificing resolve, healing welts under her armor, an iron whip and fire-ship torches.

World (fixed): year 2190, the Wu carrier fleet in orbit above an ocean world: crimson starships and carriers, a glowing nebula, the planet's blue oceans and storm clouds below, neon running lights on the hulls. Her costume, weapon and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) a sleek armored bodysuit — thin, long plates on the shoulders, arms and legs that follow her curves closely; 2) heavy assault bulk — big, thick shoulder and leg armor, a broad upper silhouette and large thrusters on the back and legs, while the torso stays fitted and the waist narrow; 3) several rigid jointed armor plates flaring from the waist like a skirt — plates, not cloth — with the legs showing between them; 4) minimal thin armor with large thrusters at the calves and ankles — a light, fast, forward-leaning silhouette; 5) separate armor pieces rather than one shell — plates on the shoulders, forearms, chest, waist, thighs and shins, with a dark fitted inner suit showing between them; 6) complete full-body armor with plates joined seamlessly from neck to feet — bare skin only on the face and where EXPOSURE allows, dense visible seams and joints; 7) a slender torso with oversized mechanical forearms and lower legs — huge gauntlets and boots — the contrast is the main shape; 8) mecha armor shaped like a medieval knight's plate — big rounded pauldrons, a breastplate, layered plates below the waist, a head ornament instead of a helmet so her face shows; 9) several long rigid jointed plates hanging from behind the shoulders to the ankles like a cape — plates, not cloth; 10) one long segmented mechanical tail reaching from the back of her waist, tipped with a weapon or ornament. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her legend, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like feathers, scales or petals, a hem or sleeve cut into a motif from her story. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Weapon (fixed — ours): an iron whip, rebuilt as a far-future high-tech version of the same kind of object with the same silhouette: hard-surface alloy plates with panel lines, mechanical joints, vents and emitter nodes, an energy edge, plasma blade or glowing core in her glow-line colour and small status lights, with any animal motif re-sculpted as sleek machined armour and no wood, silk tassels or forged-bronze fittings.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): violet hair. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Skin tone (fixed — ours): fair skin. Keep exactly this skin tone.

Costume colours (ours): crimson red, gold, river teal, black lacquer.

Mecha (fixed): she is a female mecha personification — her whole body is covered in solid hard-surface mecha armour plates with visible thickness, joints, panel lines and glow lines, never cloth or a gown; no cloth robe, gown, skirt or long fabric over the plates — any cape, skirt or wing is rigid armoured plates. Her face and hair stay human.

Rank (fixed): she is a famed war general — her costume must read battlefield might at first glance: imposing, richly worked armour and cloth with flagship-card detail, never plain or sparse.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin — never a long face or a long, pointed or heavy jaw; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline and never lengthens her face. Her eyes stay at a natural open size — never squeezed into narrow slits.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her crown or headpiece to both boots stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every genre; her hands and her signature item stay inside the frame. Camera at chest height with natural portrait perspective — no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour and skin tone), another costume shape from the list with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; a far-future setting only — no traditional East-Asian architecture, pagodas or tiled roofs; no hanzi; no logo or watermark.

Chosen original design: costume shape 9, several long rigid jointed armor plates hanging behind the shoulders to the ankles like a mechanical cape. Crimson and black-lacquer armor with gold edges and river-teal joints; cape panels constructed as hinged fire-ship hull blades with orange reactor light between layers, not fabric. A fitted armored torso, substantial pauldrons and greaves, visible plate thickness, vents and panel lines. Bare upper arms and upper thighs at symmetrical designed openings; intimate areas covered. Strong curving adult figure. Violet hair in a sleek chin-length asymmetrical bob with tucked side locks, emerald eyes, small soft heart face and rounded chin, subtle plum eyeliner, calm resolute expression. Three-quarter frontal standing stance, one high-tech iron whip with alloy joints and glowing orange emitter core held across the front at hip height, her other hand loose beside the hip. An observation hangar in year 2190 with crimson carriers and the blue ocean world beyond its panoramic window, bright neutral daylight and crisp rim light.
